d: When massive alligators take over ponds, backyards and unexpected corners of Florida, the Gator Boys are called in to take control! Paul Bedard, Jimmy Riffle and Ashley Lawrence face a series of challenging alligator rescue and removal missions, taking on aggressive nuisance gators that won't make capture easy. From daring hand-catching attempts to high-stakes relocation missions, these alligator trappers put their skills and courage to the test.
